## Body

Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES
PR: #275
Head: fffd75d08efb49e5875ad0efbebcf901c455bb73
Base: 8f798be429f9fdaf3b35c777006d06a53d603bdb
Scope: changed behavior and added public text, under C21, C33 and C34.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No security vulnerabilities found | - |

Authority is not widened. Bearer authentication and peer-scope middleware still precede the handler (crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:813-816,832-859). Parent/prime override authorization remains unchanged under the lock, AFTER the new wait, not before it (crates/daemon/src/http/revive.rs:568-602). The helper grants no authority.

The wait completes before spawn-lock acquisition and returns no pane observation to the decision (revive.rs:336-358,408-414). The locked path rereads the registry and probes current process identity and pane presence (revive.rs:159-193,550-556). A present matching pane or unverifiable listing still refuses; pane reuse visible to the locked check cannot authorize revival over that pane (revive.rs:182-193,550-602). PID reuse remains Recycled rather than Dead (crates/core/src/liveness.rs:23-33). Descriptor retirement uses a transactional comparison and the same spawn guard continues into launch (crates/store/src/registry.rs:59-74; revive.rs:703-710).

Policy versus brake: dead-process observation decides eligibility (policy); a present or unverifiable pane vetoes launch (brake). The wait does not remove that brake.

Non-security timing/cost note: the helper uses a monotonic Tokio deadline and 250 ms sleeps (revive.rs:323-324,350-357), but FIVE SECONDS IS A POLLING BUDGET, NOT A HARD END-TO-END REQUEST BOUND. A control-reply wait can take three seconds (crates/tmux/src/control.rs:34,282-292); unavailable control queries can fall back to synchronous Command::output without an explicit timeout at that layer (crates/tmux/src/lib.rs:338-342,457-461,860-862). Therefore an in-flight pane read can exceed the polling deadline, and zero subprocess launches is true only of the healthy persistent-control path. The nominal 21 helper reads exclude the later locked observation. This is a correctness/performance clarification, not a security blocker under C33; the correctness reviewer should grade it and the caller timeout margin. No separate live-fleet cost measurement was performed by this security review.

Changed-text inspection found no added secrets, credentials or C21 private home paths across the four changed files. This is not a repository-history secret scan.
